how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-shadowglen-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:458:obj:0: Seek out the dryad known as ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:458:details:0: Thank goodness you are here, ⟦1⟧. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.
rows.quest:458:details:1: The mysterious woodland protector, ⟦E1⟧, has returned to ⟦E2⟧. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of ⟦E3⟧ in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.
rows.quest:458:details:2: Seek out ⟦E1⟧ and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
rows.quest:458:completion:0: I see you found me, young ⟦2⟧. Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you.
rows.quest:5842:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5842:details:1: As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to ⟦E5⟧ in ⟦E2⟧. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:5842:details:2: Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5842:progress:0: Greetings! It is a pleasure to meet you!⟦3⟧⟦4⟧I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.
rows.quest:5842:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦5⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E6⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
rows.quest:456:obj:0: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:456:details:0: Greetings, ⟦6⟧. I am ⟦E7⟧. My purpose in ⟦E2⟧ is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.
rows.quest:456:details:1: The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.
rows.quest:456:details:2: Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large. ⟦E2⟧ can only produce so much food for the beasts. Journey forth, young ⟦7⟧, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
rows.quest:456:progress:0: There is still work to be done, ⟦8⟧. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber and thistle boar populations.
rows.quest:457:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
rows.quest:457:details:0: Thinning the younger population of creatures here in ⟦E2⟧ was a good start, ⟦10⟧, but there is still work to be done.
rows.quest:457:details:1: The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed. Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land. Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
rows.quest:457:progress:0: Your task is not yet complete, ⟦11⟧. Return to me once 7 mangy nightsabers and 7 thistle boars have been killed.
rows.quest:457:completion:0: You have proven your dedication to nature well, ⟦12⟧. A young ⟦13⟧ like yourself has a promising future.
rows.quest:459:details:0: Something evil is brewing in the forests of ⟦E9⟧. Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell. They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.
rows.quest:459:details:1: Only the corruption of wicked ⟦E8⟧ could cause such a transformation. The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:459:details:2: Engage these grells and grellkin, ⟦14⟧, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:459:progress:0: Satisfy my suspicions, ⟦15⟧. Bring to me 8 ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:459:completion:0: Your service to the creatures of ⟦E2⟧ is worthy of reward, ⟦16⟧.⟦17⟧⟦18⟧You confirmed my fears, however. If the grells have become tainted by the ⟦E8⟧, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.⟦19⟧⟦20⟧Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able ⟦21⟧, seek out the knowledgeable druid, ⟦E10⟧. He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
rows.quest:916:details:0: I came to ⟦E2⟧ to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave. They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.
rows.quest:916:details:1: First, I would like some of their venom. Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north. I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
rows.quest:916:progress:0: Did you gather the venom sacs, ⟦22⟧?
rows.quest:916:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦23⟧. When I return to ⟦E14⟧ I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders. It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
rows.quest:3519:details:0: Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.
rows.quest:3519:details:1: Please tell ⟦E15⟧. She will be able to help me.
rows.quest:3519:completion:0: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen ⟦E16⟧ yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
rows.quest:3521:obj:0: Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies, and 1 ⟦E17⟧ for Dirania Silveshine in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:3521:details:0: We may be able to help ⟦E16⟧, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.
rows.quest:3521:details:1: I'll need Hyacinth ⟦E19⟧. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.
rows.quest:3521:details:2: The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned ⟦E16⟧, collect Webwood ichor.
rows.quest:3521:progress:0: Please, collect the ingredients, ⟦24⟧. ⟦E16⟧ needs our help.
rows.quest:3521:completion:0: Thank ⟦E20⟧ that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!
rows.quest:3521:completion:1: In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
rows.quest:3522:obj:0: Bring ⟦E21⟧ to ⟦E16⟧ before the time limit is up. ⟦E16⟧ can be found by the cave to the north.
rows.quest:3522:details:0: The antidote is ready, ⟦25⟧. Please see that ⟦E16⟧ drinks it.
rows.quest:3522:details:1: There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.
rows.quest:3522:progress:0: Oh... ⟦27⟧, I'm so glad you have returned.
rows.quest:3522:completion:1: Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!
rows.quest:3522:completion:3: I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.
rows.quest:3522:completion:4: I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
rows.quest:4495:obj:0: Find ⟦E16⟧ by the cave to the north.
rows.quest:4495:details:0: A friend of mine named ⟦E16⟧ usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.
rows.quest:4495:details:1: I admit, I am a little worried, ⟦29⟧. ⟦E16⟧ spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!
rows.quest:4495:details:2: If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
rows.quest:4495:completion:0: I'm so glad you found me, ⟦30⟧. How did you know I was here?
rows.quest:917:obj:0: Bring a ⟦E22⟧ to Gilshalan in Aldrassil.
rows.quest:917:details:0: Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study. Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young ⟦31⟧. And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!
rows.quest:917:details:1: But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.
rows.quest:917:details:2: There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave. Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
rows.quest:917:progress:0: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, ⟦32⟧? Did you find a spider egg?
rows.quest:917:completion:0: Ah, very good. I will have this egg and the venom transported to ⟦E14⟧, then return there when my studies are done here. I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, ⟦33⟧. You have been a great help to me.
rows.quest:920:details:0: ⟦34⟧, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.
rows.quest:920:details:1: We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
rows.quest:920:completion:0: Ah, ⟦35⟧. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
rows.quest:921:obj:0: Fill the ⟦E24⟧ and bring it back to ⟦E23⟧ atop Aldrassil.
rows.quest:921:details:0: It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, ⟦36⟧. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.
rows.quest:921:details:1: Much has changed with our people since the Battle of ⟦E26⟧. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the ⟦E27⟧...
rows.quest:921:details:2: There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
rows.quest:921:progress:0: The moonwells hold the waters of the ⟦E28⟧, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.⟦37⟧⟦38⟧The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to ⟦E20⟧, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
rows.quest:921:completion:0: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of ⟦E26⟧. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through ⟦E9⟧ and into ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:928:details:0: While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of ⟦E9⟧, I must send you along. ⟦E30⟧ will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.
rows.quest:928:details:1: Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of ⟦E2⟧, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.
rows.quest:928:details:2: Mind you stay on the road though, ⟦39⟧. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
rows.quest:928:progress:0: Greetings, ⟦40⟧. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
rows.quest:928:completion:0: Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.
rows.quest:928:completion:1: I think we'd best get started.
